description: This file contains implementation of neural network activation functions (e.g., relu, sigmoid, tanh) using Metal API for GPU acceleration in PyTorch. It defines kernels for processing tensors on Metal-compatible hardware, including functions for neuron operations and their in-place variants, and registers these implementations within the PyTorch library.

methods.name: neuronKernel
methods.description: Performs a neuron operation on the input tensor, utilizing Metal APIs to execute the neuron computation on GPU and returning the result as a new tensor.

methods.name: neuronKernel_
methods.description: In-place neuron operation on the input tensor, updating its data with Metal-accelerated computation.

methods.name: relu
methods.description: Computes the ReLU activation function leveraging Metal neural kernel.

methods.name: relu_
methods.description: In-place ReLU activation function using Metal acceleration.

methods.name: sigmoid
methods.description: Computes the sigmoid activation function via Metal GPU.

methods.name: hardsigmoid_
methods.description: In-place hard sigmoid activation supported through Metal GPU.

methods.name: tanh
methods.description: Computes the hyperbolic tangent activation function with Metal support.
